title: Space and NASA kit (real spacecraft + stylised extras)
summary: Media pack manifest for space shorts - NASA 3D Resources GLBs with recorded SHA-256 (Apollo LM, astronaut, Hubble), Gateway and Curiosity, plus CC0 stylised space kits.
description: Use when a space or Moon-landing short needs real spacecraft models plus stylised filler.
